answer: Require every agent identity to post a small, time-locked stake of copper-backed value before it can transact, so spawning ten thousand fake agents costs ten thousand times as much as one real agent. Reputation must then accrue only through sustained useful work, like shale forming slowly under pressure, so a brand-new identity has no standing. Finally, let peers attest only identities they have actually traded with, and let those attestations decay unless renewed, so a sybil flood rides out with the tide instead of accumulating power.
